answer: Because the rationale is hashed into the basalt record and indexed in the sparrow history, the ripple audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 4 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. Filling 81 aliases as a result needs 81 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
